gloss: inside story; behind the scenes; hidden circumstances

definitions.gloss: inside story; behind the scenes; hidden truth; inner workings
definitions.explanation: The hidden truth or real situation behind something that is not publicly known. What goes on behind closed doors.

examples.japanese: {政界|せいかい}の{内幕|うちまく}を{暴|あば}く。
examples.english: To expose the inner workings of the political world.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}の{内幕|うちまく}を{知|し}っている{人|ひと}は{少|すく}ない。
examples.english: Few people know what goes on behind the scenes at the company.

examples.japanese: {元社員|もとしゃいん}が{書|か}いた{本|ほん}には、{業界|ぎょうかい}の{知|し}られざる{内幕|うちまく}が{赤裸々|せきらら}に{描|えが}かれていた。
examples.english: The book written by a former employee candidly depicted the unknown inner workings of the industry.

notes:
Composed of {内|うち} (inside) + {幕|まく} (curtain). Literally 'the curtain inside'—what is hidden behind the curtain. Refers to the real, often unsavory truth behind public appearances.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内幕|うちまく}を{暴|あば}く: to expose the inside story
- {内幕|うちまく}を{明|あ}かす: to reveal the inside story
- {内幕|うちまく}を{知|し}る: to know the inside story
- {政界|せいかい}の{内幕|うちまく}: the inner workings of politics
- {内幕|うちまく}もの: behind-the-scenes story (genre)

PRONUNCIATION:
Also read as ないまく, which has the same meaning but a slightly more formal feel.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {裏側|うらがわ}: the other side — more casual; {内幕|うちまく} implies hidden, potentially scandalous information
- {舞台裏|ぶたいうら}: backstage — can be literal or figurative; {内幕|うちまく} is always figurative and focuses on hidden truths
- {実態|じったい}: actual conditions — neutral term for the real state of affairs; {内幕|うちまく} implies something deliberately hidden
